materialdesignicons-webfont.ttf

Vendored from the Pictogrammers Material Design Icons project for offline
use when the "MDI local" add-on option is enabled (no internet access
required to preview or use MDI icons).

Source: https://github.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign-Webfont
